newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile court lifts GasAndes pipeline injunctions.
newsitem.headline: Chile court lifts GasAndes pipeline injunctions.

text.p: A Chilean court has lifted two injunctions on the GasAndes pipeline, allowing the project to begin pumping gas Thursday from Argentina as planned, said a spokesman for the group.
"Today (the court) lifted the two injunctions. GasAndes can start pumping gas from today. There is no delay," he said.
The court based its ruling on technical reports which showed that security measures protecting the pipeline from mud and rock slides have been completed.
The project is owned by a consortium headed by Chilean generator Chilgener and Canadian energy firm NOVA Corp.

The court imposed the injuctions this month to stop GasAndes from pumping gas after complaints from residents in the town of San Alfonso that the measures would not be ready in time for the project's start-up.
The project will pump natural gas to Santiago across the Andes from Mendoza in central Argentina.
